sentence: Feed your goonies before they get hangry. Feed yourself first.

wombos.definition: Irritable or short-tempered as a direct result of being hungry.
wombos.example: Sorry I snapped at you — I was just hangry before dinner.

wombos.definition: Genuine, grounded friends who consistently have good opinions (goonions) — the opposite of looksmaxxers, clout chasers, and pick-mes.
wombos.example: Skip the clout chasers and stick with your goonies.
